TEXT.id: 8. ko nimanokzos so asa ka kois
TEXT.citation: Rau, D. V., & Dong, M. N. (2006). Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary. Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica.
TEXT.BibTeX_citation: @book{rau2006yami, title={Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary}, author={Rau, D Victoria and Dong, Maa-Neu}, year={2006}, publisher={Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica}}
TEXT.source: ['8. ko nimanokzos so asa ka kois', '我射死了一隻豬', 'I killed a pig', '', 'si apen Ogaog (M, 69, Iranmilek)', '黃馬期，男，69，東清村', '']

S.FORM: mi-ci-ciwciw namen a ka-k-anak-an am, ma-níring si Akay ta icialaw am,
S.PHON: miciciwciw namən a kakanakan am maniriŋ ʂi akaj ta icialaw am
S.FORM: miciciwciw namen a kakanakan am, maniring si Akay ta icialaw am,
S.PHON: miʨiʨiwʨiw namən a kakanakan am maniɻiŋ ɕi akaj ta iʨialaw am
S.TRANSL: 當我們一群小孩子正在追逐玩耍的時候，我的祖父就說，
A group of us kids were fooling around when my grandfather said,

S.FORM: "imo rana, manga apo ko am, ángay pala do ora ta, ta si m-ian so ma-ngay do ora ta am, to mo na vonó-a an" koan na yaken a.
S.PHON: im[o|u] rana maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] am aŋaj pala ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta ta ʂi mian ʂ[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta am t[o|u] m[o|u] na v[o|u]n[o|u]a an k[o|u]an na jakən a
S.FORM: "imo rana, manga apo ko am, angay pala do ora ta, ta si mian so mangay do ora ta am, to mo na vonoa an" koan na yaken a.
S.PHON: im[o|u] ɻana maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] am aŋaj pala ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta ta ɕi mian ʂ[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta am t[o|u] m[o|u] na f[o|u]n[o|u]a an k[o|u]an na jakən a
S.TRANSL: ＂親愛的孫子，你去看看我們的芋田，如果有豬進到我們的田裡，你就戳了它的眼睛＂ 祖父這樣跟我說
"Dear Grandson, go in our taro field and see if any pigs are around. If there is one, poke out its eyes."

S.FORM: "a ji sia mang-avay", "a i-pang-avay da no ma-ngay do ora ta" koan na.
S.PHON: a ʥi ʂia maŋavaj a ipaŋavaj ɖa n[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: "a ji sia mangavay", "a ipangavay da no mangay do ora ta" koan na.
S.PHON: a ʥi ɕia maŋafaj a ipaŋafaj ɖa n[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: ＂他們（飼主）會罵人（我們）呢？＂ ＂是他們的（豬）進入我們田裡呢，怎麼還罵人？＂ 他說
"Won't they (the owners of the pigs) be angry (with us)?" "If (their pigs) are intruding our field, they can't blame us."

S.FORM: "nohon, a ajin o cinalolot?" "a ori do dang", k-owsok ko rana.
S.PHON: n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n a aʥin [o|u] cinal[o|u]l[o|u]t a [o|u]ri ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ k[o|u]wʂ[o|u]k k[o|u] rana
S.FORM: "nohon, a ajin o cinalolot?" "a ori do dang", kowsok ko rana.
S.PHON: n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n a aʥin [o|u] ʨinal[o|u]l[o|u]t a [o|u]ɻi ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ k[o|u]wʂ[o|u]k k[o|u] ɻana
S.TRANSL: ＂好吧，那長矛呢？＂ ＂在那裡！＂ ，我（拿了長矛）就下去了
"Okay, where's the spear?" "There." So I took it and went to the fields.

S.FORM: mi-ke-yray a rako a aviik do atngeh no aviao am, "nona, o ya o mi ko", to ko pang-sad-a.
S.PHON: mikəjraj a rak[o|u] a aviik ɖ[o|u] atŋəʁ n[o|u] avia[o|u] am n[o|u]na [o|u] ja [o|u] mi k[o|u] t[o|u] k[o|u] paŋʂaɖa
S.FORM: mikeyray a rako a aviik do atngeh no aviao am, "nona, o ya o mi ko", to ko pangsada.
S.PHON: mikəjɻaj a ɻak[o|u] a afiik ɖ[o|u] atŋəɰ n[o|u] afia[o|u] am n[o|u]na [o|u] ja [o|u] mi k[o|u] t[o|u] k[o|u] paŋʂaɖa
S.TRANSL: 兩隻公豬在蘆葦叢下一起睡覺，我想＂嗯，這就是我要 的＂ ，於是就刺了下去
Two hogs were lying under the reeds asleep, and I thought, "Here is a pig I can stick "and I raised my spear and struck it.

S.FORM: "yik" koan na, "wo, ásio ya? ji mang-avay sira do ya ji ni-ma-ngay do ora namen ori", to mi-ikik a, am ásio pa a, ni-ma-wákwak rana.
S.PHON: jik k[o|u]an na w[o|u] aʂi[o|u] ja ʥi maŋavaj ʂira ɖ[o|u] ja ʥi nimaŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra namən [o|u]ri t[o|u] miikik a am aʂi[o|u] pa a nimawakwak rana
S.FORM: "yik" koan na, "wo, asio ya? ji mangavay sira do ya ji nimangay do ora namen ori", to miikik a, am asio pa a, nimawakwak rana.
S.PHON: jik k[o|u]an na w[o|u] aɕi[o|u] ja ʥi maŋafaj ɕiɻa ɖ[o|u] ja ʥi nimaŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa namən [o|u]ɻi t[o|u] miikik a am aɕi[o|u] pa a nimawakwak ɻana
S.TRANSL: 豬＂咿咿＂ 的叫著，＂噢，完了，它沒有到我們的田裡（卻被我刺殺了），一定會被人罵慘了？＂ ，豬繼續的咿咿叫，它哪裡還有什麼（命）？死了

The hog started squealing loudly, and I thought, "Oh, no! It wasn't even in our field yet, and I killed it. Its owner will be very angry!" The pig continued squealing. How could it be still alive? The pig died.

S.FORM: m-oli ko rana am, "mo Akay!" "ikongo ang?"
S.PHON: m[o|u]li k[o|u] rana am m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] aŋ
S.FORM: moli ko rana am, "mo Akay!" "ikongo ang?"
S.PHON: m[o|u]li k[o|u] ɻana am m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] aŋ
S.TRANSL: 我回家後，＂祖父！＂ ＂什麼事？＂
I went back home and said, "Grandpa!" "What?"

S.FORM: "ya ko ni-wakwak o ya asa ka aviik", "a ya ni-ma-ngay do ora ta?"
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] niwakwak [o|u] ja aʂa ka aviik a ja nimaŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta
S.FORM: "ya ko niwakwak o ya asa ka aviik", "a ya nimangay do ora ta?"
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] niwakwak [o|u] ja aʂa ka afiik a ja nimaŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta
S.TRANSL: ＂我刺死了一隻豬＂ ，＂它進到我們的田裡了嗎？＂
"I killed a pig!" "Was it in our field?"

S.FORM: "beken, sia mi-ke-yray am, ko todey vono-a",
S.PHON: bəkən ʂia mikəjraj am k[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj v[o|u]n[o|u]a
S.FORM: "beken, sia mikeyray am, ko todey vonoa",
S.PHON: bəkən ɕia mikəjɻaj am k[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj f[o|u]n[o|u]a
S.TRANSL: ＂沒有，它們兩個正在睡覺的時候，我就戳了它的眼睛＂
"No, they were under the reeds asleep, and I poked its eyes."

S.FORM: "a ji da 'oya-n imo, mo tamazang a, beken o ma-ngay do ora ta o vono-en mo, manga apo ko a, apia ori?"
S.PHON: a ʥi ɖa ʔ[o|u]jan im[o|u] m[o|u] tamaʐaŋ a bəkən [o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta [o|u] v[o|u]n[o|u]ən m[o|u] maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] a apia [o|u]ri
S.FORM: "a ji da 'oyan imo, mo tamazang a, beken o mangay do ora ta o vonoen mo, manga apo ko a, apia ori?"
S.PHON: a ʥi ɖa ʔ[o|u]jan im[o|u] m[o|u] tamaraŋ a bəkən [o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta [o|u] f[o|u]n[o|u]ən m[o|u] maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] a apia [o|u]ɻi
S.TRANSL: ＂你這樣子會被人家罵呢，孫子；我是說只有進到我們田裡的豬才要戳它的眼睛；這下怎麼辦呢？＂
"I said you could poke out it's eyes if it was in the field, but what you did will anger the owner, my dear grandson! What will I do?"

S.FORM: "a k-om-oan am, mo ni-panci yaken ang", "beken a ma-ngay do ora ta o".
S.PHON: a k[o|u]m[o|u]an am m[o|u] nipanci jakən aŋ bəkən a maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ra ta [o|u]
S.FORM: "a komoan am, mo nipanci yaken ang", "beken a mangay do ora ta o".
S.PHON: a k[o|u]m[o|u]an am m[o|u] nipanʨi jakən aŋ bəkən a maŋaj ɖ[o|u] [o|u]ɻa ta [o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂有什麼辦法？是你這樣跟我說的啊＂ ，＂不是，我是說只有進到我們田裡的才要
"There is nothing we can do about it! You told me to do it!" "I said if they were in the field."

S.FORM: ika-doa na araw no nang am, makeynakan rana am, "a ji da yaten a 'oya-n, manga apo ko"
S.PHON: ikaɖ[o|u]a na araw n[o|u] naŋ am makəjnakan rana am a ʥi ɖa jatən a ʔ[o|u]jan maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u]
S.FORM: ikadoa na araw no nang am, makeynakan rana am, "a ji da yaten a 'oyan, manga apo ko"
S.PHON: ikaɖ[o|u]a na aɻaw n[o|u] naŋ am makəjnakan ɻana am a ʥi ɖa jatən a ʔ[o|u]jan maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 第二天，飼主就宰掉吃了那隻豬。＂孫子啊，人家一定會來罵我們的＂
The next day, the pig's owner butchered it. "Grandson, they will definitely be angry."

S.FORM: o kma so sang a, todey vono-a ni-pasoson da jiaken am,
S.PHON: [o|u] kma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ a t[o|u]ɖəj v[o|u]n[o|u]a nipaʂ[o|u]ʂ[o|u]n ɖa ʥiakən am
S.FORM: o kma so sang a, todey vonoa nipasoson da jiaken am,
S.PHON: [o|u] kma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ a t[o|u]ɖəj f[o|u]n[o|u]a nipaʂ[o|u]ʂ[o|u]n ɖa ʥiakən am
S.TRANSL: 像這樣的事情；本來祖父只是叫我去看看田裡是否有豬進入，我卻真的刺殺 了別人的豬。
Just like that. When they asked me to (check if any pigs entered our field), I killed one instead.

S.FORM: am ji ko a-tenng-i ta metdeh ko am,
S.PHON: am ʥi k[o|u] atənŋi ta mətɖəʁ k[o|u] am
S.FORM: am ji ko atenngi ta metdeh ko am,
S.PHON: am ʥi k[o|u] atənŋi ta mətɖəɰ k[o|u] am
S.TRANSL: 只因當時還小，不懂事
At the time I was young and didn't understand.

S.FORM: to ko i ma-nokzos so m-ian do ka-viao-an ori am, ori ni-'oya-an da niaken ni Akay icialaw.
S.PHON: t[o|u] k[o|u] i man[o|u]kʐ[o|u]ʂ ʂ[o|u] mian ɖ[o|u] kavia[o|u]an [o|u]ri am [o|u]ri niʔ[o|u]jaan ɖa niakən ni akaj icialaw
S.FORM: to ko i manokzos so mian do kaviaoan ori am, ori ni'oyaan da niaken ni Akay icialaw.
S.PHON: t[o|u] k[o|u] i man[o|u]kr[o|u]ʂ ʂ[o|u] mian ɖ[o|u] kafia[o|u]an [o|u]ɻi am [o|u]ɻi niʔ[o|u]jaan ɖa niakən ni akaj iʨialaw
S.TRANSL: 把好好睡在蘆葦叢下的豬給活活的刺死了，祖父因此對我很生氣
Because I killed the pig sleeping under the reeds, my late grandpa was angry with me.

S.FORM: karaan am, ko ji á-tenng-i a, ni-toro-an da so adoa ka mazaponay koan da sio an?
S.PHON: karaan am k[o|u] ʥi atənŋi a nit[o|u]r[o|u]an ɖa ʂ[o|u] aɖ[o|u]a ka maʐap[o|u]naj k[o|u]an ɖa ʂi[o|u] an
S.FORM: karaan am, ko ji atenngi a, nitoroan da so adoa ka mazaponay koan da sio an?
S.PHON: kaɻaan am k[o|u] ʥi atənŋi a nit[o|u]ɻ[o|u]an ɖa ʂ[o|u] aɖ[o|u]a ka marap[o|u]naj k[o|u]an ɖa ɕi[o|u] an
S.TRANSL: 後來怎麼樣我就不知道了；據說好像是賠了他們兩顆琉璃珠吧
Afterwards I don't know what happened, but I heard that they paid (them) two blue beads.
